# ORPTS — Online Research Project Tracking System

> AI-powered academic supervision platform that streamlines thesis
> supervision with intelligent document analysis, automated defense
> preparation, and AI-assisted feedback between students and supervisors.

ORPTS supports three roles — students, supervisors, and coordinators —
across the full research lifecycle: project registration, topic approval,
document versioning, threaded feedback, scheduling, and defense simulation.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the platform, features, and modules.
- [Sign in](/login): Student, supervisor, and admin sign-in.
